newsitem.title: UK: BSKYB OFF AGAIN AHEAD OF RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: BSKYB OFF AGAIN AHEAD OF RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc fell for a second session on Thursday ahead of the group's annual results, due on Friday, dealers said.
At 0947 GMT, the shares were down 9p to 472.
"There's just a bit of nervousness ahead of these figures," said one market maker.
The consensus profit estimate of analysts polled by Reuters was 303 million stg, up from 257.4 million stg reported in the previous year.
These results mark the end of an era, as the group's chief executive Sam Chisholm, who guided the company through a rapid expansion in the 1990s, steps down
